sections.heading: Relationship Workshops
sections.markdown:
**4 Lenses**
"Not sure why everyone doesn't see things your way? Clearly if they did, everything would be much better." This interactive workshop identifies which lens you use to view the world and teaches how others see it differently. Applicable to leaders, followers, family members, and partners.

**4 Lenses for Couples – Date Night**
"Hey, what are you doing on Friday? Don't worry; this is NOT some couples therapy session." Couples discover different perspectives on family, relationships, intimacy, and finances while building connection.

**5 Love Languages of Children**
Discover how to speak your child's love language in a way they understand. Participants will discover their child's love language, assist children in successful learning, use love languages to correct and discipline more effectively, and build a foundation of unconditional love.

**5 Love Languages for Couples – Date Night**
Couples learn their love languages through interaction and immediate application, discovering what works and what doesn't in relationships, including long-distance relationships. Based on Dr. Gary Chapman's bestselling book.

**7 Habits of Highly Effective Military Families**
"If motivation is what gets you started, HABITS are what keep you going." Military families learn habits and principles to transition from "we can't" to "we can" through teamwork, talent, desire, vision, and focus.

**7 Habits of Highly Effective People Signature Program**
Over this 3-day workshop, participants gain hands-on experience applying principles that empower improved communication, strengthened relationships, increased influence, and superhero-like focus on critical priorities. Off-base cost is upwards of $2,000; offered here for FREE. Seats limited to 25 per session.

**How to Avoid Falling in Love with a Jerk**
"What if you took the time to build the same relationship with the person that KNOCKS YOUR SOCKS OFF?!?" This workshop helps participants eliminate jerks/jerkettes before they have the keys to your heart and base housing by investing time in getting to know partners.

**PREP**
"Calling all couples! YES ALL COUPLES. Married, dating, committed, just met, carpooling – you're totally the right fit." Participants become Relationship Ninjas capable of fighting off rough patches. Couples spend most time in one-on-one discussions practicing skills.

**Real Relationships**
Lasting relationships take work. Adding military lifestyle creates additional challenges. Whether honeymoon is upcoming, ongoing, or over, this offers positive and proactive ways to build healthy, lasting relationships for individuals or couples.

sections.heading: Communication Workshops
sections.markdown:
**4 Lenses and the Agile Leader**
Identifies which lens you use to view the world and teaches how others see it differently. Discusses and applies Agile leader concepts and 4 Lenses to leading, communicating, and negotiating as an agile leader using SCRUM concepts.

**Basic Anger Management**
"Although disagreements and anger are a normal part of life, violent expressions of feelings detract from personal and professional relationships." Workshop provides education on anger dynamics and offers acceptable coping strategies.

**Basic Stress Management**
Learn to manage stress by changing your response to it. Identify personal symptoms of stress and personal strategies for managing stress. Understand the Combat and Operational Stress Continuum and develop an Individual Action Plan.

**Bridging the Generation Gap**
Shows unique characteristics of multiple generations today, enabling improved communication across generations through knowledge of generational characteristics, influences, and priorities. Improves relationships on professional and personal levels.

**Communication & Public Speaking to Influence & Careers**
Improve confidence in public speaking and messaging with small or large groups. Cover basics of generating messages, preparing presentations, and creating messages with power and purpose along with hands-on practical exercises.

**Conflict Management**
Participants discover characteristics of three styles for responding to conflict and three levels of conflict that lead to escalation. Learn two techniques that productively resolve conflict.

**Extended DISC**
"Extended DISC® Individual Assessments are the only DISC assessments in the world that can be customized to your unique needs and applications." Measures hard-wired DISC style to provide information on how to modify behavior for success.

**Happiness Advantage**
"Just like that, most people believe that only after they're successful will they finally be happy. Based on recent discoveries in the fields of positive psychology and neuroscience, that formula for happiness is dead wrong." Happiness fuels success; positive brains are more engaged, creative, motivated, and resilient. Based on Shawn Achor's book as taught in Harvard's famed Happiness Course.

**Leading Across Generations**
For the first time in history, four distinct generations (Traditionalists, Baby Boomers, Gen Xers, Millennials) are in the workforce with different perspectives. Participants learn to understand and leverage differences, resolve sticking points, and motivate team members.

**Leading at the Speed of Trust**
"Trust isn't a quality you either have or you don't, it's a learnable skill." High-trust teams significantly outperform those without trust. Speed of Trust Transformation Process guides individuals and organizations to create high-trust, engaged cultures focused on results.

**Say What?! Interpersonal Communication**
"Have you ever had a conversation go downhill fast when you heard the words, 'What's that supposed to mean?'" Gender, age, experiences, and style impact how we communicate. Learn fundamental mistakes most make and improve every personal and professional relationship.

**Say What?! Interpersonal Communication – Public Speaking**
Improve confidence in public speaking and messages with small or large groups. Cover basics of generating messages for various audiences, preparing messages, and creating messages with power and purpose through interactive, fun hands-on exercises.

**Speed of Trust Foundations**
"The vital currency in today's connected, collaborative world is trust. Like any other discipline, creating trust is a learnable skill." Based on Stephen M.R. Covey's best-selling book, organizations forego time-killing bureaucracies to accelerate business and results.

sections.heading: Box of Chocolates
sections.markdown:
**5 Choices for Extraordinary Productivity**
Participants establish new mindsets about where to spend their time driven by most important priorities, with skillsets and toolsets enabling them to filter out distractions, achieve highest priorities with excellence, and feel successful about accomplishments. Develop consistent processes and important people skills among unofficial project managers.

**5 Choices to Extraordinary Productivity Essentials**
Participants establish new mindsets about time-driven by important priorities, with skillsets and toolsets to filter distractions, achieve highest priorities with excellence, and feel successful. Develop consistent processes and important people skills among unofficial project managers.

**7 Habits of Highly Effective People 4.0**
Aligns timeless principles of effectiveness with modern technology and practices. Develop increased maturity, greater productivity, and ability to manage oneself. Learn to execute critical priorities with laser-like focus, increase team engagement and morale, improve communication, and strengthen relationships.

**Ready, Set, Prepare!**
"This workshop contains information regarding actions that service members and families should take to be informed and prepared in the event of natural and man-made hazards." Designed for families to prepare for all types of emergencies and increase personal sense of security and peace of mind.
